items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. It addresses 14 vulnerabilities, with 8 rated Critical, and some requiring no authentication.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, allows for unrestricted file upload, which can lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical improper output encoding vulnerability, included in APSB26-73, that could be exploited for malicious purposes.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce (unauthenticated)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-73, requires no authentication and allows an anonymous attacker to bypass security features.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-73, affecting standard Adobe Commerce stores, where malicious code can be saved and executed automatically.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Amasty extension leading to Remote Code Execution
items.summary: Sansec reported a critical vulnerability in one of 25 Amasty extensions that could lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce, Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce Webhooks Plugin
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution or file system writes.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability, part of APSB26-49, that could enable arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Path Traversal vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-49, allowing arbitrary file system writes.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and access store data.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability, part of APSB26-05, that could lead to privilege escalation, requiring admin access for exploitation.

items.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This SSRF vulnerability, included in APSB26-05, allows high-privileged attackers to manipulate server-side requests, potentially exposing sensitive data or accessing isolated internal systems.
